notes.title: ⚡ SUPERCHARGED DETECTED — We’re in MGN 2025 Steam Fest! ⚡
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562292/4c8b0fbc43c6c11c39d2bcbf9e31469f438c6bb7.png[/img]
[h1][b]Big news![/b][/h1]

[b]Supercharged [/b]just landed a feature spot in the [b]MGN 2025[/b] Steam Fest through IGU — and our demo is officially [b]LIVE on Steam[/b]!

This is huge for our small team. Supercharged is a fast-paced parkour shooter where you shoot to create, not destroy. Wall-run, build your own platforms, and find your flow in a surreal world built entirely in Unreal Engine 5.

We’re featured alongside some absolutely incredible indie titles — and we’d love for you to be part of this moment with us.

🎮 Play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644330/Supercharged_Demo/]Demo[/url] Now

❤️ Wishlist Supercharged:
Every wishlist helps us push this project further. It literally fuels the dream.

💬 Join our Discord:
Come say hi, share how far you got before falling into the void (we won’t judge… out loud).
👉 [[url=https://discord.com/invite/PbG6xfPgtS]Discord Link[/url]]

Thanks for all the love, feedback, and chaos so far.
Now let’s get this wild ride into more hands ⚡

— Team Supercharge

notes.title: The Supercharged Demo Page is LIVE — and YOU can leave a review!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562292/a7801858aa63795c917933f74e2010a2038cdaeb.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

The Supercharged Demo page is officially live on Steam!
That means you can now play the demo, Wishlist the game, AND leave a review!

🎮 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644330/Supercharged_Demo/]Play the Demo Now[/url]

If you’ve already played it, [b]dropping a quick review[/b] helps us more than you can imagine. Seriously every review pushes the game forward.

This is our[b] first public[/b] build of Supercharged — a parkour platforming shooter where your gun creates platforms instead of bullets. Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5.3, with support for controller + keyboard and smooth performance on Steam Deck & ROG Ally.

We’re aiming for a full release very soon, and this is just the beginning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562292/653682a90c3e9b9dcad9ead1303bf45f29d9e910.gif[/img]
Have feedback or ideas? Found a bug?
Hop into our Discord and tell us everything:
👉 [[url=https://discord.gg/q59euGdPYG]Insert Discord Link[/url]]

Thanks for being part of this journey. We’re building this with you. ⚡

notes.title: SUPERCHARGED DEMO IS LIVE!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562292/75956994e0b1f8d759d67aa268e14b898f62dadf.png[/img]
🚨[b] The Supercharged Demo is LIVE![/b] 🚨
Hey everyone,

We finally did it. The Supercharged demo is officially [b]live on Steam [/b]— and we couldn’t be more excited (and slightly nervous) to share it with you all.

This game has been a passion project for us — made by a small team juggling college, part-time work, and late nights. It’s been a wild, chaotic ride getting to this point, and seeing it finally out there means the world.

⚡ [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551750/Supercharged/]Play the Demo Now[/url][/b]

If you’ve been following our journey since IGDC, GDC, GamesCom or all the other events, 
[b]Thank you[/b]. 
Whether you stopped by our booth, shared your thoughts, or just watched someone else play — you’ve been a part of this.

Found a bug? Let us know on our [b]Discord[/b].
Got ideas or feedback? Drop them there — we read every single one.

👉 [[url=https://discord.gg/Aj95HPgdyY]Join the Discord[/url]]

This is just the beginning. We're aiming for a full release the game soon, and we’ll be sharing dev updates, behind-the-scenes madness, and maybe some sneak peeks along the way — all over on Discord.

Oh, and if you like what you played — [b]please Wishlist Supercharged[/b]. It helps more than you know and gets us one step closer to making this dream real.

Thank you for being here.
See you in the game. ⚡

— [b]Team Supercharge[/b]

notes.title: Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav Sale, featuring Supercharged
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are glad to announce [b]Supercharged[/b] participation in the [b]Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav[/b] Steam sale!

The sale includes over a [b]100 Games[/b] being showcased! The top indie developers from across the country are coming together and this event is connecting them with top global publishers who are looking to partner.

This also gives Indian gamers a chance to experience the best homegrown games.

It runs from [b]10th to 20th of April on Steam[/b] and Its also happening under the same roof as Mumbai Comic Con on 12th and 13th of April where you can see and experience some of these games LIVE and talk to the developers✨

Thank you!
